blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines – The Toledo Xignex Trojans are headed to the grand finals of the Professional Chess Association of the Philippines (PCAP) Wesley So Cup anew after defeating the favored Sudeco-Manila Indios Bravos in the Omega Division finals on Saturday, November 21.
